# PaintFE 1.4.2

This update fixes several keyboard and dialog problems and makes working with multiple images easier.

- Improved Windows keyboard handling, including Backspace and shortcuts after switching apps.
- Added better Tab navigation and Enter/Escape support in dialogs.
- Fixed Recover Transparency overflowing the screen.
- Fixed Save As dragging, resizing, closing, previews and zoom. It remembers your export format and starts in the current file's folder.
- Added scrolling tabs, Ctrl+Tab switching, Recent Files, thumbnails and right-click document actions.
- Made the Colors panel resizable and added right-click picking for the secondary color.
- Added adjustable tooltip delay, including instant tooltips.
- Added script cropping and batch export with overwrite protection.
- Improved portable storage fallback and AppImage storage paths.
- Added macOS DMG packaging and signing support.

Closes #143, #144, #145, #146, #147, #149, #150, #151, #152, #153 and #154.

Further testing is continuing on reported issues.
